items.title: Lawrence "Buddy" Tureaud Interview, 1972-03-06
items.q: What was your mother's name? Effie Two-Rolls.

ctx.x: Without the ticket, it's twenty-eight cents. Uh-huh. You see, and that's where we draw the crowd. Everybody was running around looking for a ticket to save that thirteen cents. See, that was a good scheme. Oh, she did wonderful. Sounds like a good scheme. Yeah. What was your mother's name? Effie Two-Rolls. Effie?
